Privacy & Cookie Policy

This notice explains how Mont°6 handles personal data when you visit the website, make an enquiry or book a stay, and how to exercise your rights under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

Last updated: 22 September 2026.

1. Data Controller

The controller of the personal data collected through this website is:
Daniele Gattuso
Cefalù, Sicily, Italy
Email: mont6.home@gmail.com

2. Personal Data Collected and Purposes

We collect and process the following data exclusively for the indicated purposes:

  • Booking Data: Stay dates, number of guests, amount, booking status, and booking-attempt and payment identifiers. After payment, we also receive the name and email address entered at Stripe Checkout and store them with the booking. This information is used to reserve the dates, verify payment, send confirmation, and manage your stay, cancellations and refunds.
  • Payment Data: Payment takes place on Stripe’s hosted checkout. Your full card number and security code (CVC/CVV) are not sent to this website or stored in our database. We receive transaction identifiers, the amount and payment status; Stripe may display partial payment-method details to the host, such as the card brand and last four digits, to identify a transaction and provide support.
  • Enquiries and messages: If you contact us by email or WhatsApp, we use your contact details and message content to reply and arrange your stay. Do not send full card details through these channels. This website does not provide an identity-document upload form.
  • Technical data: When you browse, the services that deliver and protect the website process request data such as IP address, date and time, requested page, browser information and errors. This supports website operation, troubleshooting and abuse prevention. The cookies section explains browser storage, the map and website statistics.

The data needed to confirm a booking and process payment is necessary for these services; without it, we cannot complete an online booking. A general consent to privacy processing is not required for this purpose. We do not use booking data to send newsletters or advertising.

3. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your data based on the following conditions:

  • Performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps requested by you (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR): answering enquiries and managing bookings, payments, stays and support.
  • Compliance with legal obligations (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR): tax and administrative records and stay-related duties, including reporting to the competent authorities. Any additional data required to identify guests is collected through arrival procedures, not through this website’s booking form.
  • Legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR): protecting the website and bookings from abuse, diagnosing errors, measuring visits and performance in aggregate, and protecting rights in a dispute, to the extent necessary and taking account of individuals’ rights and freedoms.

4. Services used and recipients

  • Cloudflare hosts and protects the website, runs booking functions and stores booking records in its D1 database. It also provides the statistics described in the cookies section. Cloudflare privacy policy.
  • Stripe processes payments and helps prevent fraud. Depending on the service, it processes data on the host’s behalf or for its own purposes, including legal duties. Stripe privacy policy.
  • Resend sends booking confirmations and service notices. It receives the email address, name and message content, including stay dates and amount. Emails are also handled by the host’s and recipient’s email providers. Resend privacy policy.
  • OpenStreetMap Foundation receives technical data needed to deliver map images, such as your IP address. OpenStreetMap privacy policy.
  • WhatsApp is involved only if you choose to follow its link and use the service to contact us. The link is not an embedded website chat. WhatsApp privacy policy.

Data may be disclosed to the competent authorities where required by law and to tax or legal advisers as necessary for their work. Booking data is not published on the website; the public calendar shows availability without guests’ names or contact details.

5. Processing outside the European Economic Area

Providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Their terms describe transfer safeguards, including, where applicable, adequacy decisions and the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses. Resend states that its primary processing operations take place in the United States. Data is therefore not necessarily kept exclusively in Italy or the European Union.

You can read the published data-processing terms of Cloudflare, Stripe and Resend, as well as the privacy notices of the other services listed above. For information about safeguards relating to your data, contact the controller using the email address on this page.

6. Data retention

Retention depends on the type of data and its purpose. The criteria are:

  • Enquiries without a booking: the time needed to reply and complete follow-up correspondence, taking account of unresolved disputes.
  • Bookings, payments and confirmations: management of the stay, cancellations, refunds and disputes, followed by the tax and administrative retention obligations applicable to each record. These criteria do not mean that copies of identity documents are retained for the same period.
  • Booking attempts and technical logs: the time needed to verify transaction outcomes, prevent duplicates and abuse, and troubleshoot problems; an incident or dispute may require records to be kept while it is addressed. A payment attempt expiring does not automatically delete every related technical record.
  • Cookies and browser storage: according to the duration and arrangements described in the cookies section below, or until cleared by the user.

You can ask about retention for a specific booking and request deletion of your data. Requests are assessed in light of legal obligations and any need to protect legal rights.

7. Your rights

Subject to the conditions and limits in the GDPR, you may request access, rectification, erasure and restriction of processing. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests on grounds relating to your particular situation. You may exercise data portability for data you provided that is processed by automated means based on a contract or consent. Write to mont6.home@gmail.com; proportionate information to verify your identity may be requested where necessary to protect your data.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante) or another competent supervisory authority, particularly in the EU Member State where you habitually reside or work, or where you believe an infringement occurred.

8. Cookies and preferences

This website does not use third-party profiling or advertising tracking cookies (such as Facebook Pixel or Google Analytics).

The essential mont6_lang cookie remembers your language for one year. Local storage remembers that you dismissed the cookie notice; session storage keeps your selected dates and booking attempt identifier so you can resume the process without duplicating it.

Payment takes place on Stripe’s secure page, where Stripe manages its own security and fraud-prevention tools. The map loads images from OpenStreetMap, which receives technical request data such as your IP address.

Essential cookies do not require consent. We do not use optional cookies to accept or reject. You can clear site cookies and storage in your browser settings; this removes your saved preferences.

The site also uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure visits and performance, without cookies or local storage to track users. Read the privacy notices from Cloudflare, Stripe and OpenStreetMap.
